title: Travelers deploys AI-powered claims countrywide with OpenAI
summary: Travelers built an AI-powered Claim Assistant with OpenAI to guide customers through filing claims, provide 24/7 support, and scale operations during peak demand.
body: Travelers built an AI-powered Claim Assistant with OpenAI to guide customers through filing claims, provide 24/7 support, and scale operations during peak demand.
summaryZh: 旅游者保险公司（Travelers）宣布与OpenAI合作，在全美范围内正式部署AI驱动的理赔助手（Claim Assistant）。该系统旨在全天候引导客户完成理赔申请流程，并在业务高峰期有效扩展公司的客服与运营规模，是企业级大模型真实落地的典型案例。

aiReview.reasonZh: 展示了大型保险公司在全国范围内大面积部署基于大模型的理赔助手应用的实际落地案例。
